verdict.rationale: Rainforest supports per-merchant pricing control via Billing Profiles and a buy-rate/interchange-plus model where platforms fully control what they bill merchants, and amount-splits let platforms take a fee/markup on each transaction. However, there's no evidence of a dashboard or report that explicitly separates the platform's earned revenue (fees/markup) from underlying processing costs — only pricing-calculator tools and billing-profile configuration are documented. Missing for 10: dedicated revenue-vs-cost reporting/dashboard, explicit application-fee API object, and independent confirmation of per-seller pricing flexibility beyond docs claims.
